OFFICE MEMORANDUM
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Dungarpur
Date: 11 September 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/218)
Subject: Physical Verification of Biometric Attendance and Office Punctuality Logs (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Dungarpur division are hereby informed that under 'Physical Verification of Biometric Attendance and Office Punctuality Logs', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 16 September in the central nodal wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #318) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Dungarpur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and nodal movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Dungarpur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #128, 3. Digital Indexing.
Chief Accounts Officer
Dinesh Kumar Gurjar
solution_steps: 1. Click inside the Third Paragraph.
2. Click Justify and Hanging Indent (0.75").
